meta.title: d-trash
meta.description: Manage session trash and move local session logs to system trash.

trash.confirmDelete: Move “{title}” to system trash? It can be recovered at the system level.
trash.confirmEmpty: Move all sessions in trash to system trash? They can be recovered at the system level.
trash.deleteFailed: Could not move session to system trash: {reason}
trash.emptyFailed: Could not move all sessions to system trash: {reason}
trash.sessionLockBusy: This session is open or in use. Switch to another session or restart DSH, then retry Move to system trash. Loaded sessions may remain locked after switching.
trash.physicalDeletion: Moves local session logs to system trash for system-level recovery. Put Back metadata is not guaranteed on macOS.
trash.purgePending: Move or cleanup is unfinished. Retry Move to system trash to complete cleanup.
trash.deferred: Pending move to system trash (automatically retries after restarting DSH)
trash.deferredNotice: Queued for moving to system trash. Restart DSH to retry; Restore cancels the queue. {reason}
trash.clipboardUnavailable: Clipboard access is unavailable in this context.
trash.copyErrorUnknown: Clipboard write failed without an error message.
trash.copyManually: Full ID selected below. Press Cmd/Ctrl+C to copy.
trash.distillNotice: Sends the read-only transcript to the DSH default model using the selected preset in a separate task session. All tool execution is denied. The source stays in trash. Manual export runs no model.
trash.distillNoAgents: No agent presets available. Refresh to retry.
trash.distillFailed: Distillation failed; choose an agent again to retry: {reason}
trash.distillPromptSaved: Prompt saved. Send it to your agent to complete distillation; no model was run.
trash.distillFileHint: Copy this path and open it in your editor or file manager.
